examples.arabic: كلنا قلنا له دي مش خطة كويسة
examples.english: All of us told him, 'This is not a good plan'.
examples.transliteration: Kollena oulna lo dī mish khuṭṭa kwayyesa.

examples.arabic: هتصل بيه بكره عشان نكمل الخطة
examples.english: I will call him tomorrow to continue the plan.
examples.transliteration: Hatessel beeh bokra ashan nakammel el khotta.
